annotations.title: Look up an advisor or firm by name

description: Use this when the person names a specific advisor or firm and wants to know whether Wellspent lists them as fee-only, or wants their profile. Matches advisor names, firm names and places in the public graph, which holds only advisors Wellspent treats as fee-only. A match gives the slug for get_advisor_profile and a link. No match does not mean the advisor isn't fee-only: the graph doesn't cover everyone, and the name may be spelled differently. Cite "Source: Wellspent, find.wellspent.co".

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-10).

name.description: An advisor's name, a firm's name, or both (e.g. "Jane Doe", "Doe Wealth"). A city or state can be added to narrow it.

name: find_advisor_or_firm_by_name
title: Look up an advisor or firm by name
